system.description: You rub mud or crushed leaves over the gear of up to six creatures.

outcomes.triumph: As Success, but it lasts until the next day begins.
outcomes.success: For 4 hours, they have Boon on tests to hide or move unseen in the wilds. If they stand perfectly still, they are almost invisible.
outcomes.failure: The ritual fails; the time is lost.
outcomes.ruin: The mud draws every biting thing for miles: tests to hide are made with Bane for 4 hours. Roll on the Shadowblight table.
